628-3899-7217.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Moonshadow.
When Moonshadow dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability
Repeat.

2034-3499-3755-6970-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

2446-3259-4359.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2446-3259-4359.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Living Hive, triggering Breath of Fury and Living Hive.
Resolve the Living Hive trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1843-3259-4885.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1843-3259-4885.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Tervigon, triggering Breath of Fury and Tervigon.
Resolve the Tervigon trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

4050-5086-5183-6705-7743.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
4050-5086-5183-6705-7743.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 1.

3617-5900-7722.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Time Walk, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Lilysplash Mentor.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Time Walk from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Time Walk from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

3967-5003-7283-7649.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Thorin.
When Thorin dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Thorin from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Thorin enters, it triggers, attaching Nim Deathmantle to Raphael, and then having Raphael deal 6 damage to itself.
Raphael triggers, adding six {R}.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.
3967-5003-7283-7649.notes: Once you have infinite mana, the damage dealt to Raphael can instead be dealt to any creature(s).

1409-3883-7498-7544.easyPrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Biblioplex Tomekeeper.
1409-3883-7498-7544.description:
Cast a copy of Wheel of Fortune from exile by paying {2}{R}, unpreparing Naktamun Lorespinner.
Resolve the copy of Wheel of Fortune, causing each player to discard their hand, drawing seven cards, and creating seven Treasure tokens for each opponent due to Hullbreacher.
Activate Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding mana.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying that mana, flickering Biblioplex Tomekeeper and pairing with it again as it enters.
When Biblioplex Tomekeeper enters, it triggers, preparing Naktamun Lorespinner.
Repeat.

957-1987-4423-7487.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
957-1987-4423-7487.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Zealous Lorecaster.
When Zealous Lorecaster and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Zealous Lorecaster trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Time Stretch from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Stretch during your draw step.
Repeat during your second extra turn

457-1458-4404-4985.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
457-1458-4404-4985.description:
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to Jhoira's Familiar.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Banishing Knack.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Banishing Knack by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Avatar Kuruk

3908-7009-7334.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn
3908-7009-7334.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Neutrinos.
3908-7009-7334.description:
Activate Spark Double using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Declare The Neutrinos as an attacker, triggering its ability, blinking Spark Double. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn.

1558-6741-7309.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five multicolored permanents.
1558-6741-7309.description:
Cast Infinite Guideline Station either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Infinite Guideline Station enters, it triggers, creating a 2/2 Robot artifact creature token for each multicolored permanent you control.
Activate Infinite Guideline Station's station ability by tapping any number of creatures with total power 12 or greater, putting at least twelve charge counters on Infinite Guideline Station, causing it to become a creature.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Robots, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Don & Leo triggers, blinking Infinite Guideline Station.
When Infinite Guideline Station enters, it triggers, creating a 2/2 Robot artifact creature token for each multicolored permanent you control.
Repeat from step 3 each turn.

1339-6092-7307.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1339-6092-7307.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Raphael triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1020-2866-3836-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Urza.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {C}{C}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Urza.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

969-2872-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Clever Conjurer.
Activate one of the Clever Conjurer tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Clever Conjurer token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

5413-5531-6621-6763.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
5413-5531-6621-6763.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Repeat.

1477-2558-5727-6705.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, The Prydwen triggers.
Holding priority, activate Extruder by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Prydwen trigger, creating a 2/2 Human Knight and a 1/1 Frog creature token.
When the Frog enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Soldier.
Repeat from step 2.

4050-5968-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
4050-5968-5972.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Ghostly Dancers triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

654-1445-2366-5184-6413.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
654-1445-2366-5184-6413.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding Dryad Arbor.
Green Goblin's second ability triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
When the Treasures enters the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers twice, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card.
Green Goblin's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a Goblin you control.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1329-2178-3652-5147.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-2178-3652-5147.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Ornithopter from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Ornithopter from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Ornithopter.
When Ornithopter dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Extus, Oriq Overlord // Awaken the Blood Avatar

2091-4050-4558-4863.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents control at least ten tapped lands.
2091-4050-4558-4863.description:
Cast Mana Geyser by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Extus triggers, returning Revolutionist from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Mana Geyser, adding {R} for each tapped land your opponents control.
Cast Revolutionist by paying its mana cost.
When Revolutionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Mana Geyser from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Revolutionist, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

2533-2719-5963.description:
Activate Marvin by sacrificing it, returning Sakashima of a Thousand Faces from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Loyal Retainers.
Activate Sakashima of a Thousand Faces by sacrificing it, returning Marvin from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Loyal Retainers.
Repeat.

501-586-997-5258-5618.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1, causing you to scry 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

4094-5189-5231-5439.notablePrerequisites:
Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
There is at least one removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
4094-5189-5231-5439.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Adaptive Gemguard by tapping the Saprolings, putting a +1/+1 counter on Adaptive Gemguard.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing a Saproling, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 2.

732-1284-1636-4939.notablePrerequisites:
Viridian Longbow attached to Felhide Spiritbinder.
Felhide Spiritbinder does not have summoning sickness.
732-1284-1636-4939.description:
Activate Felhide Spiritbinder by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Burning-Tree Emissary by paying {R/G}{R/G}.
Burning-Tree Emissary enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Intruder Alarm.
Resolve the Burning-Tree Emissary trigger, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Felhide Spiritbinder triggers, holding priority, activate it by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Felhide Spiritbinder trigger, causing you to pay {1}{R} to create a token copy of Burning-Tree Emissary with haste.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Halvar, God of Battle // Sword of the Realms

2034-2146-3874-5222.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of the Realms attached to Armory Automaton.
"Artifact" or "Creature" chosen with Cloud Key.
2034-2146-3874-5222.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Armory Automaton, adding {C}{C}.
Armory Automaton dies, triggering Sword of the Realms, returning Armory Automaton from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Armory Automaton by paying {2}.
Armory Automaton enters the battlefield, attaching Sword of the Realms to it.
Repeat.

1769-2201-3300-4187.description:
Cast Rot Hulk by paying {5}{B}{B}.
Rot Hulk dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
The Meathook Massacre triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Rot Hulk's enter the battlefield trigger is put onto the stack.
Resolve the Rot Hulk trigger, returning Rot Hulk from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
